trap-negation-contrast.notes: TWO ITEMS REPORTED, not fixed. (1) NOTATION VIOLATION AND AN INTERNAL COLLISION IN ONE SENTENCE: 'let $\mathcal{N}(Z, N)$ ... be a nucleus with proton displacement $\delta p = p - p_{\mathrm{stab}}(A)$' uses BOTH $Z$ and $p$ for the proton count, in the same clause. notation-collisions reserves $p$ for the brane point and specifies $Z$ for the proton count (the proton itself is \mathfrak{p}). (2) DANGLING DEFINITION: $\delta p$ is defined in the hypothesis and then never used - neither the half-life formula nor any factor mentions it. Either use it or drop it.
